summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  **What I did:** Read-only trace of the entire path (no files edited): `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `client/src/hooks/useAuth.tsx` → `server.ts` routing/CORS → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → `db/auth.ts` (sessions/cookies).  **What I found:** Contrary to the ticket's premise, I could not find the described bug in the current code. Every link in the chain looks correctly wired: - Watchlists/items are scoped by `user_id`/`watchlist_id` on every read, writ
